raw_blocks: Weatherford Integrated Services offers solutions tailored to the needs of our customers and the challenges of their projects. Our integrated management teams work collaboratively as extensions of your taskforce and partners in your success across well construction, production, and abandonment. As a result, we streamline operations from conception to completion and execute the right services with a comprehensive portfolio of technologies. Combining the best-fit project delivery model, goal-oriented service integration, and customer-centric project management, we elevate the customer experience and deliver results.
As part of every integrated project, our client-focused approach uses three core components to align all services in an effortless way and establish a clear path for success.

We align our offerings to your end goal and project requirements. Delivered by dedicated teams, our comprehensive integrated solutions improve well construction to bring wells to production earlier, extend the life of wells and reservoirs to produce more and longer, and execute effective abandonment to finish responsibly.

From planning to execution, we collaborate with you for on-time and on-budget delivery according to the project scope. To further realize value and improve execution, our project managers effectively communicate to foster transparency and continuous engagement so that the project achieves gains aligned with your strategy and vision.

Regardless of the project scope or business model used to address commercial and operational risks, we always work with you to implement cost-effective integrated solutions. By incorporating the best-suited technologies, streamlining all activities, and proactively managing all interfaces, we deliver your objectives while mitigating risk from project startup to closeout.

Our integrated well construction solutions help you to advance overall efficiency, mitigate potential risks, overcome changing conditions, and deliver wells earlier. We tailor our solutions using a powerful portfolio with automated and digital technologies, leveraging in-house expertise, and integrating third-party management. This results in the simplification of complex drilling and completions projects.
Integrated Intervention and Production Solutions

Our integrated intervention and production solutions transform existing and mature assets so you can produce for longer. We customize our digitalization and project management capabilities to identify production opportunities, rank intervention activities, and select those with higher returns. Further, we combine our technologies for cost-effective intervention, well servicing, stimulation, artificial lift, and Production 4.0 to integrate various operations into one workflow, restore productivity without a rig, extend asset life, and forecast potential recovery.

In an era that includes environmental accountability alongside a company’s reputation and fiscal obligations, the end of the well lifecycle is just as integral as the beginning. Plug and abandonment is a difficult process that presents many technical, operational, economic, and social challenges.
Reach Out to Explore Results

With the best-fit project delivery model, goal-oriented service integration, and customer-centric project management, Weatherford Integrated Services looks to enhance your experience while delivering results. Let us know about the challenges of your well construction, production, or abandonment project. One of our specialists will continue the conversation with you soon.
Thank you for contacting us.
Your request is being directed to the appropriate person in our organization.
We will be in touch soon.
